# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 6 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 6 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_006_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 6

**6:1** The child grew stronger with each passing day. At six months of age, her mother placed her on the ground to test whether she could stand. She took seven steps and came back to her mother's arms. Anna caught her up and said: "As the Lord my God lives, you shall not walk on this ground again until I bring you into the temple of the Lord."

**6:2** Anna made a sanctuary of the child's bedchamber and allowed nothing common or unclean to enter it. She summoned the undefiled daughters of the Hebrews to come and attend to her.

**6:3** On the child's first birthday, Joachim held a great feast and invited the priests, scribes, elders, and all the people of Israel. He presented the child to the priests, and they blessed her: "O God of our fathers, bless this child and give her a name that will be remembered for all generations." And all the people responded: "So be it. Amen."

**6:4** He then brought her to the chief priests, and they blessed her: "O God Most High, look upon this child and bless her with the highest blessing that cannot be exceeded."

**6:5** Her mother then carried her up into the sanctuary of the bedchamber and nursed her. And Anna sang a song to the Lord God, saying: "I will sing a holy song to the Lord my God, for he has visited me and removed the reproach of my enemies. The Lord God has given me the fruit of his righteousness — singular yet manifold before him. Who will go and tell the sons of Reuben that Anna nurses a child? Hear it, hear it, O twelve tribes of Israel: Anna nurses a child!"

**6:6** She laid the child to rest in the sanctuary of the bedchamber and went out to serve her guests. When the feast was over, they departed rejoicing and glorifying the God of Israel.
